thread:
ops_bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 - Metering delay detected - job 'usage-agg-east' missed 4 consecutive windows. Alert: batch ingestion lag -> potential delayed usage reports/overage flags. PagerDuty: oncall-eng-east alerted.

sarah: seeing a spike in 'unprocessed_tokens' queue, +120k in last 15m. Any recent deploys?

raj: no deploys on serving in last 2 hours. Checking consumer logs + Kafka lag now.

billing_bot: FYI: first downstream overage flag fired at 02:07 UTC for cust: acme-inc. Count delta vs expected: +18.2%

danielle: looks like the nightly batch that marks finalized usage didn't finish—saw timeout in `usage-aggregator` around 01:50 UTC. Stacktrace: 
```
2026-03-15T01:50:12Z ERROR aggregator.main: Timeout waiting for s3 list after 300s
  File "/app/agg/run.py", line 210, in process_window
    entries = s3.list_objects(prefix=prefix)
```

emily: that matches customer reports of delayed invoices. We should hold automatic overage notifications until reconciliation. Can we re-run the window?

sarah: I can kick a reprocess but want to ensure we don't double-charge. Proposed steps: 1) Pause overage flagging + customer alerts 2) Re-run ingestion for windows 01:00-02:30 UTC 3) Reconcile counts and generate diff report 4) Unpause with manual approval.

raj: running quick check on Kafka consumer group: consumer_group: usage-agg-east-cg. Lag: 320k messages behind, leader partition on broker-b-3 which had transient network spike at 01:48 UTC. I'm going to promote replica and trigger controlled restart on broker-b-3.

ops_bot: PagerDuty update: oncall-eng-east -> raj acknowledged. Escalation timer set to 20m.

billing_bot: Hold on auto-billing: API call sent to billing-control to set `hold_overage_notifications=true` for all customers affected by window 2026-03-15T01:00Z-02:30Z. Response: accepted.

danielle: prepping reprocess run. Command I will use: 
```
./scripts/reprocess_window.sh --start 2026-03-15T01:00:00Z --end 2026-03-15T02:30:00Z --env prod --dry-run=false
```

raj: quick note — we need to clear the KV-cache prefix that the aggregator uses or you'll re-ingest partial state. Run this before reprocess: `redis-cli -n 5 EVAL "return redis.call('del', KEYS[1])" 1 usage:kv:window:20260315:01`

sarah: reprocess started at 02:13 UTC. monitoring tail: `tail -n 200 /var/log/usage-agg/proc.log`. Early output: windows 01:00 and 01:15 succeeded, 01:30 still requeueing.

emily: notifying CS to hold outbound emails: @cs-team please pause any billing outreach for events in window 01:00-02:30 until we confirm reconciliation.

raj: broker-b-3 restarted and replica promotion complete. Kafka consumer group lag down to 12k and steadily decreasing. No data loss observed.

danielle: reprocess finished at 02:34 UTC. Generated reconciliation artifact: s3://redwood-recon/2026-03-15/usage-recon-2134567890.csv.gz (checksum: sha256:abcd1234...).

billing_bot: preliminary reconciliation shows token counts decreased vs flagged counts by ~2.1% after reprocess for the affected window. Overage flags recalculated. We removed provisional overage flags for 48 customers; 3 customers still have legitimate overages and should be billed.

sarah: created INC ticket INC-3482 and set priority P1 -> 'Metering delay: late ingestion causing provisional overage flags'. Assigning to billing-sre and infra.

emily: drafted customer-facing note for affected customers: short apology, explanation that we paused notifications and only charged verified usage, timeline, and next steps. Will send after legal sign-off.

raj: recommended follow-ups: 1) add circuit breaker on s3 listing to fail faster + fall back to incremental fetch 2) improve broker restart automation 3) add metric `provisional_overage_count` to alert earlier.

danielle: adding runbook entries: commands used, KV-cache clearing, and reconciliation path. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/712 (WIP)

ops_bot: Incident update at 02:45 UTC - status: mitigating. Impact: delayed usage & provisional overage flags for subset of customers; billing pause enforced; partial reconciliation completed.

sarah: handing off to raj for post-incident remediation and longer-term fixes. Oncall handoff: @raj you're taking post-mortem and action items.

raj: acknowledged, will own the post-mortem. Key action items: automate hold_on_large_recon_delays, add alerting for kafka consumer lag > 50k.

emily: once legal + finance ok, we'll send customer note and close incident. k, thx everyone :heart: 

ops_bot: Incident resolved and documentation linked to INC-3482. Closing thread.
